title: Under legacy layout (compatibilityMode 14 or none) a wrapSquare picture anchored to the last paragraph that fits a page stays on that page and overflows the bottom margin, pulled up only at the paper edge; a column-wide picture turns the page only when its anchor line no longer fits below it
source: build.py -> Word for Mac direct PDF (2026-11-03), pymupdf image/line bboxes: A4 pgMar 509/851 (body 25.45 .. 799.37), Arial 11 line 240 after 0, 39 filler lines (line 39 at 506.2), anchor paragraph top 518.8, picture posOffset V 10.95 pt; one nextPage section per case. A: 299.5 pt square at column +133 pt, empty anchor paragraph -> image 529.7-829.2 on page 1, NEXT 531.7 beside it. B: same with 'Anchor text' (519.0) -> identical. C: 330 pt tall -> 511.9-841.9 (pulled up to the paper edge). E: 557.5 x 200 column-wide -> 529.7-729.7, NEXT 742.6 below it. D: 557.5 x 330 column-wide -> filler ends page 5, image at page 6 36.4-366.4, NEXT 379.3

cases.note: A: NEXT stays beside the overflowing picture
B: a text anchor paragraph behaves the same
C: the 330 pt picture is pulled up to the paper edge, nothing turns
E: the column-wide 200 pt picture fits with its anchor line below it
D: the anchor paragraph of the column-wide 330 pt picture opens page 6

E: NEXT 742.6 = picture bottom 729.7 + the anchor paragraph's own 12.65 pt line, pushed under the column-wide picture; gen puts NEXT at the picture bottom (the band wrapper drops the anchor line, open)
